concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-006 mandates generation of reproducible Jupyter notebooks containing all code and final visualizations. The current tasks list contains no task that creates, validates, or verifies notebooks, leaving this requirement uncovered.

Success Criterion SC-006 requires validation of the correlation coefficient calculation against a manual verification script with error margin < 1e‑6. No task in the list produces or runs such a verification script, so the criterion cannot be measured.
